reason: `ControlClient` gains the required method `bringPrismaSpaceUpToDate`, so a `createClient` factory passed to `executeMigrateShowPlan` must return a client that has it (prisma/orm#31234).
Its `space` now needs only a space's contract, migration graph, head reference and migrations, so the Prisma space, which has no folder on disk, can be passed (prisma/orm#31234).
